Linked Data (SKOS)

UN/LOCODE is available as a SKOS vocabulary in Turtle format, making it interoperable with semantic web tools, SPARQL endpoints, and other linked data systems.

This format is under active development and may change. We welcome feedback via Slack. See the SKOS documentation for details on the vocabulary structure.
